integrity: Reproducible finite certificate and two differently parameterized exhaustive programs. Coefficients and maximal lengths were checked by replay, not inferred from examples.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite results only for the labeled rook and Shrikhande graphs with 16 vertices; complete published-literature coverage and independent external audit are not claimed.
title: Closed and open Grundy domination spectra of the rook and Shrikhande graphs
